test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). S is the immediate neighbour of T and W. U is to the immediate right of T. V is the immediate neighbour of U and W. Who is sitting to the immediate left of S?
solution:
Given: S, T, U, V and W. 

1) U is to the immediate right of T. 

2) V is the immediate neighbor of U and W. 

3) S is the immediate neighbor of T and W. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22a681714c2f227fb651dd3757f91c4f67354e1ed8827659272645d46b6bb681.png] 

Here, 'W' is sitting to the immediate left of S.

Hence, the correct answer is **"W"**.
